results.title: Rachin Ravindra reveals how Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma have shaped his batting
results.description: Rachin Ravindra has voiced his deep admiration for Indian cricket icons Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma, crediting them for shaping his playing style and mentality. His standout performances in the 2023 ODI World Cup have spotlighted his talents. Following New Zealand's recent triumph in India, their confidence has surged, propelling them into future matches. Ravindra emphasizes his commitment to the team's success over personal glory.
